verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers a beta business bank account (via Increase Bank) and a Money Dashboard, so the treasury axis applies. The evidence does not mention a high-yield savings sub-account, interest or yield, or automated transfer rules. A basic checking account and cash-flow view are adjacent features and earn no credit for building a yield-bearing cash cushion.
